title: ELEPHANT: MEASURING AND UNDERSTANDING SOCIAL SYCOPHANCY IN LLMS
reasoning: The paper introduces and benchmarks 'moral sycophancy', which evaluates how LLMs respond to moral dilemmas and interpersonal conflicts. It specifically uses datasets like 'r/AmITheAsshole' to measure whether models affirm a user's side in a moral conflict regardless of the underlying wrongdoing, testing the consistency of their moral and value judgments.
